_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, credit cost, expense, nonperforming-asset and pre-tax margin signals with JPMorgan Chase's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading global financial services firm and one of the largest banking institutions in the United States' 'JPMorgan Chase’s results of operations could be adversely affected by U.S. and international markets and economic conditions.' 'The Firm’s consumer businesses are particularly affected by domestic economic conditions' 'There is increasing competition in the financial services industry which may adversely affect JPMorgan Chase’s results of operations.' (FY2007 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (its one use of the word is for consumer loan losses: the LOW and SHW reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a bank holding company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -79.2%/yr (worst year FY03-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -11.5%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.0-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS -11.5%/yr (FY03-FY08 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +61.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY08, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: JPM (retrospective, 2009-01-16) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (98.2% downside to Bear $0.40 / -17.4% upside to Bull $18.86) | Adj composite 1.35 vs market 2.86: gap -1.51 [OVERVALUED] | +91% above the EPP floor $11.96 (13x FY09E $0.92) | Conservative 2-yr case: -33.9% total (-16.9%/yr) | At 24.8x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $30.18 sits above the BULL case; revenue -0.9% YoY in Q4 2008, forward revenues -0.9% (Q4 2008 revenue growth (no Q1 2009 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
